name: Titanium.Media.Sound
summary: An object for playing basic audio resources.
description:
The `Sound` object loads the entire media resource in memory before playing.  If you need to 
support streaming, use the [AudioPlayer](api:Titanium.Media.AudioPlayer) API.

You can control how the sound interacts with other system sounds
by setting [Titanium.Media.audioSessionCategory](api:Titanium.Media#audioSessionCategory).

Use the [Titanium.Media.createSound](api:Titanium.Media#createSound) method to create a `Sound` object. You can play audio 
in any format supported by the target platform(s), as described in the following documents:

* [Android](https://developer.android.com/guide/topics/media/media-formats#core)
* [iOS](https://developer.apple.com/audio/)

properties.name: allowBackground
properties.summary: Determines whether the audio should continue playing even when its activity is paused.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_ALARM
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for alarms.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_MEDIA
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for media playback.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_NOTIFICATION
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for notifications.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_RING
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for the phone ring.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_SIGNALLING
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for DTMF tones or beeps.

properties.name: AUDIO_TYPE_VOICE
properties.summary: Used to identify the volume of audio streams for voice calls.

properties.name: audioType
properties.summary: Changes the audio-stream-type.

properties.name: duration
properties.summary: Duration of the audio resource.
properties.description:
On iOS, playback time is reported in seconds.

On Android, time is reported in milliseconds.

Android note: Starting from Titanium 3.2.0, the remote audio plays asynchronously. The duration
can only be fetched after the audio is initialized (refer to [Titanium.Media.Sound.STATE_INITIALIZED](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#STATE_INITIALIZED)).

properties.name: looping
properties.summary: Determines whether the audio should loop upon completion.

properties.name: paused
properties.summary: Indicates if the audio is paused.
properties.description:
On iOS, this property is read-write, and you can pause and resume playback by setting this
property to `true` or `false`.

On Android, this property is read-only. For portability, use [pause](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#pause)
to pause audio, and [play](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#play) to resume.

properties.name: playing
properties.summary: Indicates if the audio is playing.

properties.name: STATE_BUFFERING
properties.summary: Audio data is being buffered from the network.

properties.name: STATE_INITIALIZED
properties.summary: Audio playback is being initialized.

properties.name: STATE_PAUSED
properties.summary: Playback is paused.

properties.name: STATE_PLAYING
properties.summary: Audio playback is active.

properties.name: STATE_STARTING
properties.summary: Audio playback is starting.

properties.name: STATE_STOPPED
properties.summary: Audio playback is stopped.

properties.name: STATE_STOPPING
properties.summary: Audio playback is stopping.

properties.name: STATE_WAITING_FOR_DATA
properties.summary: Player is waiting for audio data from the network.

properties.name: STATE_WAITING_FOR_QUEUE
properties.summary: Player is waiting for audio data to fill the queue.

properties.name: time
properties.summary: Current playback position of the audio.
properties.description:
Time is reported in milliseconds.

On iOS, prior to Release 3.0, playback time is reported in seconds.

properties.name: url
properties.summary: URL identifying the audio resource.

properties.name: volume
properties.summary: Volume of the audio from 0.0 (muted) to 1.0 (loudest).
properties.description:
This setting controls the volume of the sound relative to the overall
volume setting for the device.

On iOS, to adjust the volume of the device, set the `volume` property of
[Titanium.Media.appMusicPlayer](api:Titanium.Media#appMusicPlayer) and set the [Titanium.Media.audioSessionCategory](api:Titanium.Media#audioSessionCategory) property
to either [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_SOLO_AMBIENT](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_SOLO_AMBIENT),
[Titanium.Media.AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_PLAYBACK](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_PLAYBACK),
or [Titanium.Media.AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_PLAY_AND_RECORD](api:Titanium.Media#AUDIO_SESSION_CATEGORY_PLAY_AND_RECORD).

methods.name: isLooping
methods.summary: Returns the value of the [looping](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#looping) property.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.summary: Returns the value of the [paused](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#paused) property.

methods.name: isPlaying
methods.summary: Returns the value of the [playing](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#playing) property.

methods.name: play
methods.summary: Starting playing the sound, or resume playing a paused sound.

methods.name: release
methods.description:
This is typically unnecessary but can be useful if you load a large audio file in `app.js`, and 
play it only once and you would like to release all resources after your final play to reduce memory.

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Resets the audio playback position to the beginning.

methods.name: setLooping
methods.summary: Sets the value of the [looping](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#looping) property.

deprecated.notes: Set the value of the [looping](Titanium.Media.Sound.looping) property directly.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.summary: Sets the value of the [paused](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#paused) property.
methods.description:
On iOS, this method can be used to pause and unpause playback. For portability,
it is preferable to use the [pause](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#pause) and
[play](api:Titanium.Media.Sound#play) methods instead.

deprecated.notes:
It is preferable to use the [pause](Titanium.Media.Sound.pause) and
[play](Titanium.Media.Sound.play) methods instead.

parameters.name: paused
parameters.summary: Pass `true` to pause the current playback temporarily, `false` to unpause it.

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stops playing the audio and resets the playback position to the beginning of the clip.

events.name: change
events.summary: Fired when the state of the playback changes.
events.description:
This event can be generated by programmatic events, such as pausing or stopping the audio,
and also by external events, such as the current state of network buffering.

properties.name: state
properties.summary: Current state of playback.

properties.name: description
properties.summary: Text description of the state of playback.

events.name: complete
events.summary: Fired when the audio has finished playing.

properties.name: success
properties.summary:
Indicates if the sound was played successfully.
Returns `true` if request succeeded, `false` otherwise.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: Error message, if any returned. Will be undefined if `success` is `true`.

properties.name: code
properties.summary:
Error code.
Error code will be `0` if `success` is `true`, nonzero otherwise. If the error
was generated by the operating system, that system's error value is used.
Otherwise, this value will be `-1`.

events.name: error
events.summary: Fired when an error occurs while playing the audio.

properties.name: success
properties.summary: Indicates a successful operation. Returns `false`.

properties.name: error
properties.summary: Error message, if any returned. May be `undefined`.

properties.name: code
properties.summary:
Error code.
If the error was generated by the operating system, that system's error value
is used. Otherwise, this value will be `-1`.

properties.name: message
properties.summary: Error message.

events.name: interrupted
events.summary: Fired  when audio playback is interrupted by the device.
events.description: Typically called during an interruption due to an incoming phone call.

events.name: resume
events.summary: Fired when audio playback is resumed after an interruption.

properties.name: interruption
properties.summary: Indicates if the resume was from an interruption.
